export APP_ICON="zed"
export APP_ARGS="%%U"
export APP_NAME="Zed"
export APP_ID="dev.zed.Zed"

export BRANDING_DARK="#1a5fb4"

%(installroot)%(bindir)/zed --completions bash | %install_file /dev/stdin %(installroot)%(bashcompletionsdir)/%(name)

# enable LTO here instead

export ZED_UPDATE_EXPLANATION="Package updates are provided via moss"
export LIBSQLITE3_SYS_USE_PKG_CONFIG=1
export OPENSSL_NO_VENDOR=true
export ZSTD_SYS_USE_PKG_CONFIG=1

zfs.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/0001-Stateless.patch

# ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: __start_zfs_tunables
export LDFLAGS+=" -Wl,--no-gc-sections"

%configure \
    --disable-static \
    --disable-sysvinit \
    --enable-systemd \
    --with-config=user \
    --with-mounthelperdir=%(sbindir) \
    --with-pamconfigsdir=%(vendordir)/pam.d \
    --with-udevdir=%(libdir)/udev \
    --with-vendor=aerynos \
    --without-dracutdir
zfs.install:
# There is a race condition in the installation code
# that manifests when using 8 jobs (but YMMV, race conditions
# are unpredictable). Use 1 job as a safety net.
%make_install -j1

%tmpfiles "# Make sure that the /etc/zfs directory exists so that ZFS can write to it"
%tmpfiles "d /etc/zfs 0755 root root"

# Unneeded
rm -rfv %(installroot)%(datadir)/initramfs-tools

zfs-module.setup:
%patch %(pkgdir)/linux-7.3-iops-create-no-flag.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/linux-7.3-bvec-iter-bi-offset.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/linux-cpu-feature-enabled.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/linux-7.3-kthread-init-fs.patch
%patch %(pkgdir)/bump-Linux-Maximum-7.3.patch

# Regenerate configure/configure.ac after patching
autoreconf -fi

# config.status runs `$SED` as a command; zfs' configure leaves it unset
sed -i -e 's|\$SED|sed|g' configure

for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    mkdir ${_kernel}

    pushd ${_kernel}
    ../configure \
        --prefix=%(prefix) \
        --with-config=kernel \
        --with-linux=%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/build \
        --with-linux-obj=%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/build \
        KERNEL_ARCH=x86_64 \
        KERNEL_CC=%(cc) \
        KERNEL_LD=%(ld) \
        KERNEL_LLVM=1

    popd
done
zfs-module.build:
for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    pushd ${_kernel}
    %ccache_zero
    export CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}"
    %make
    %ccache_stats
    popd
done
zfs-module.install:
for _kernel in ${kernels[@]}; do
    pushd ${_kernel}
    %make_install \
        INSTALL_MOD_PATH=%(installroot)%(prefix) \
        INSTALL_MOD_DIR=extra/fs/zfs

    # We don't need to build _against_ the kernel modules (yet?)
    rm -rfv %(installroot)/usr/src

    # Manually construct the debug info from the kernel modules
    %install_dir %(installroot)%(libdir)/debug/.build-id
    pushd %(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}
    module_list=()
    while IFS=  read -r -d $'\0'; do
        module_list+=("$REPLY")
    done < <(find . -type f -name "*.ko" -print0)
    for module in "${module_list[@]}"; do
        build_id=$(${READELF} -n ${module} | awk '/Bui/ {print $3}')
        debug_path="%(libdir)/debug/.build-id/${build_id:0:2}/${build_id: 2}.debug"

        pushd $(dirname ${module})
        file=$(basename ${module})

        llvm-objcopy --only-keep-debug "${file}" "${file}.debug"
        llvm-objcopy --add-gnu-debuglink "${file}.debug" "${file}"
        llvm-strip -g --strip-unneeded "${file}"
        %install_file "${file}.debug" "%(installroot)/${debug_path}"
        rm -v "${file}.debug"

        popd
    done
    popd

    # Compress modules with zstd
    find "%(installroot)%(libdir)/modules/${_kernel}/" -name '*.ko' -print -exec zstd {} \; -exec rm -v {} \;

    popd
done
zfs-module.environment:
# Create list of kernels to build for
declare -a kernels=()
for dir in %(libdir)/kernel/*/; do
    dir=${dir%*/}
    kernels+=(${dir##*/})
done

zip.environment:
make_args="-f unix/Makefile prefix=%(prefix)"

# Make sure we build with large file support and bzip2 support. The configure script would ordinarily handle this but we're not using that
export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS} -DLARGE_FILE_SUPPORT -DBZIP2_SUPPORT"
export LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS} -lbz2"

zk.build:
# fts5 tag is what upstream's Makefile builds with, the full text search needs it
export CGO_ENABLED=1
export GOFLAGS+=" \"-ldflags=-linkmode=external -s -w -buildid= -X=main.Version=v%(version)\""
go build -v -buildvcs=false -tags fts5 -o zk .
zk.check:
# boulder sets HOME to the build dir, not /root, so TestExpandPath can never pass in here
go test -tags fts5 -skip TestExpandPath ./...

zlib-ng.setup:
# Defining BUILD_SHARED_LIBS disables the static library (which we only want for the compat build)
%cmake -B build-zlib \
    -DZLIB_COMPAT=ON \
    -DWITH_GTEST=OFF \
    -DINSTALL_LIB_DIR=%(libdir)

%cmake -B build-zlib-ng \
    -DZLIB_COMPAT=OFF \
    -DWITH_GTEST=OFF \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON \
    -DINSTALL_LIB_DIR=%(libdir)
zlib-ng.build:
for i in build-zlib build-zlib-ng; do
    %ccache_zero
    BUILDDIR=${i}
    env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}/${i}" %cmake_build
    %ccache_stats
done
zlib-ng.install:
for i in build-zlib build-zlib-ng; do
    BUILDDIR=${i}
    %cmake_install
done
zlib-ng.check:
for i in build-zlib build-zlib-ng; do
    BUILDDIR=${i}
    env CCACHE_BASEDIR="${PWD}/${i}" %cmake_test
done

zxing-cpp.setup:
# we don't need cmake as a python dependency
sed -r -i '/cmake/d' wrappers/python/pyproject.toml
sed -i 's/pybind11\[global\]/pybind11/' wrappers/python/pyproject.toml

# ZXING_PYTHON_MODULE=ON builds the Python shared library but not the metadata, so we still need to build the wheel with pyproject
%cmake \
    -DSTB_IMAGE_INCLUDE_DIR=%(includedir)/stb \
    -DZXING_C_API=ON \
    -DZXING_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DZXING_PYTHON_INSTALL_LIBDIR=%(libdir) \
    -DZXING_PYTHON_MODULE=ON \
    -DZXING_USE_BUNDLED_ZINT=OFF \
    -DZXING_WRITERS=BOTH
zxing-cpp.install:
%cmake_install

pushd wrappers/python
%pyproject_install
popd

# Substitute the python shared library built by pyproject which is statically linked with the shared one built by cmake
python_version=$(python -c 'import sys; print(".".join(map(str, sys.version_info[:2])))')
pushd %(installroot)%(libdir)/python${python_version}/site-packages/zxingcpp/
python_lib=$(find . -type f -iname "zxingcpp.abi3*")
mv -f %(installroot)%(libdir)/${python_lib:2} .
patchelf --remove-rpath ${python_lib}

# Not needed since it's built by the wheel
rm -rfv %(installroot)%(libdir)/*.{py,pyi,typed}
